validation_attempt_history.name: webkit-install-probe

validation_attempt_history.name: missing-generated-assets-and-webkit-libraries
validation_attempt_history.detail: After dependencies were linked,missing generated mobile engine modules and unavailable WebKit system libraries caused11 file failures:44 tests failed,46 passed,33 skipped. Generated ignored outputs and isolated WebKit cache setup resolved these failures.

validation_attempt_history.name: postinstall-preflight
validation_attempt_history.detail: pnpm attempted its automatic dependency verification first and rejected the symlink hoist directory. No successful dependency install occurred. The existing mobile postinstall generators then completed and produced the required ignored assets.

validation_attempt_history.name: focused-typecheck-initial
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing benchmark background-task discrimination and callback-assigned sink narrowing failed focused TypeScript checking. Checked narrowing and a typed sink object resolved both; final focused check passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: initial-benchmark
validation_attempt_history.detail: The6 retained benchmark arms passed before the final checked-type cleanup. Final run records its own checksum and duration.

validation_attempt_history.name: webkit-install-probe
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing WebKit download was available but its bundled wrapper hid inherited library paths. An isolated cache wrapper under /tmp uses existing extracted compatibility libraries; both engines subsequently passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: form-mutation-bounded-readiness
validation_attempt_history.detail: Both engines failed at the expected10-second navigation precondition after forms capability was denied. The original runner required AssertionError and rejected this result. The retained second attempt also uses no-navigation settling so the independent top-navigation count assertion is reached and fails on both engines.

validation_attempt_history.detail: After dependencies were linked,missing generated mobile engine modules and unavailable WebKit system libraries caused11 file failures:44 tests failed,46 passed,33 skipped. Generated ignored outputs and isolated WebKit cache setup resolved these failures.

validation_attempt_history.name: postinstall-preflight
validation_attempt_history.detail: pnpm attempted its automatic dependency verification first and rejected the symlink hoist directory. No successful dependency install occurred. The existing mobile postinstall generators then completed and produced the required ignored assets.

validation_attempt_history.name: focused-typecheck-initial
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing benchmark background-task discrimination and callback-assigned sink narrowing failed focused TypeScript checking. Checked narrowing and a typed sink object resolved both; final focused check passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: initial-benchmark
validation_attempt_history.detail: The6 retained benchmark arms passed before the final checked-type cleanup. Final run records its own checksum and duration.

validation_attempt_history.name: webkit-install-probe
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing WebKit download was available but its bundled wrapper hid inherited library paths. An isolated cache wrapper under /tmp uses existing extracted compatibility libraries; both engines subsequently passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: form-mutation-bounded-readiness
validation_attempt_history.detail: Both engines failed at the expected10-second navigation precondition after forms capability was denied. The original runner required AssertionError and rejected this result. The retained second attempt also uses no-navigation settling so the independent top-navigation count assertion is reached and fails on both engines.

validation_attempt_history.name: dependency-probe-skips
validation_attempt_history.detail: Before compatible mobile dependencies were linked:2 files passed,9 skipped;16 tests passed,107 skipped. No browser coverage claimed from this run.

validation_attempt_history.name: missing-generated-assets-and-webkit-libraries
validation_attempt_history.detail: After dependencies were linked,missing generated mobile engine modules and unavailable WebKit system libraries caused11 file failures:44 tests failed,46 passed,33 skipped. Generated ignored outputs and isolated WebKit cache setup resolved these failures.

validation_attempt_history.name: postinstall-preflight
validation_attempt_history.detail: pnpm attempted its automatic dependency verification first and rejected the symlink hoist directory. No successful dependency install occurred. The existing mobile postinstall generators then completed and produced the required ignored assets.

validation_attempt_history.name: focused-typecheck-initial
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing benchmark background-task discrimination and callback-assigned sink narrowing failed focused TypeScript checking. Checked narrowing and a typed sink object resolved both; final focused check passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: initial-benchmark
validation_attempt_history.detail: The6 retained benchmark arms passed before the final checked-type cleanup. Final run records its own checksum and duration.

validation_attempt_history.name: webkit-install-probe
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing WebKit download was available but its bundled wrapper hid inherited library paths. An isolated cache wrapper under /tmp uses existing extracted compatibility libraries; both engines subsequently passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: form-mutation-bounded-readiness
validation_attempt_history.detail: Both engines failed at the expected10-second navigation precondition after forms capability was denied. The original runner required AssertionError and rejected this result. The retained second attempt also uses no-navigation settling so the independent top-navigation count assertion is reached and fails on both engines.

validation_attempt_history.name: dependency-probe-skips
validation_attempt_history.detail: Before compatible mobile dependencies were linked:2 files passed,9 skipped;16 tests passed,107 skipped. No browser coverage claimed from this run.

validation_attempt_history.name: missing-generated-assets-and-webkit-libraries
validation_attempt_history.detail: After dependencies were linked,missing generated mobile engine modules and unavailable WebKit system libraries caused11 file failures:44 tests failed,46 passed,33 skipped. Generated ignored outputs and isolated WebKit cache setup resolved these failures.

validation_attempt_history.name: postinstall-preflight
validation_attempt_history.detail: pnpm attempted its automatic dependency verification first and rejected the symlink hoist directory. No successful dependency install occurred. The existing mobile postinstall generators then completed and produced the required ignored assets.

validation_attempt_history.name: focused-typecheck-initial
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing benchmark background-task discrimination and callback-assigned sink narrowing failed focused TypeScript checking. Checked narrowing and a typed sink object resolved both; final focused check passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: initial-benchmark
validation_attempt_history.detail: The6 retained benchmark arms passed before the final checked-type cleanup. Final run records its own checksum and duration.

validation_attempt_history.name: webkit-install-probe
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing WebKit download was available but its bundled wrapper hid inherited library paths. An isolated cache wrapper under /tmp uses existing extracted compatibility libraries; both engines subsequently passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: form-mutation-bounded-readiness
validation_attempt_history.detail: Both engines failed at the expected10-second navigation precondition after forms capability was denied. The original runner required AssertionError and rejected this result. The retained second attempt also uses no-navigation settling so the independent top-navigation count assertion is reached and fails on both engines.

validation_attempt_history.name: missing-generated-assets-and-webkit-libraries
validation_attempt_history.detail: After dependencies were linked,missing generated mobile engine modules and unavailable WebKit system libraries caused11 file failures:44 tests failed,46 passed,33 skipped. Generated ignored outputs and isolated WebKit cache setup resolved these failures.

validation_attempt_history.name: postinstall-preflight
validation_attempt_history.detail: pnpm attempted its automatic dependency verification first and rejected the symlink hoist directory. No successful dependency install occurred. The existing mobile postinstall generators then completed and produced the required ignored assets.

validation_attempt_history.name: focused-typecheck-initial
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing benchmark background-task discrimination and callback-assigned sink narrowing failed focused TypeScript checking. Checked narrowing and a typed sink object resolved both; final focused check passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: initial-benchmark
validation_attempt_history.detail: The6 retained benchmark arms passed before the final checked-type cleanup. Final run records its own checksum and duration.

validation_attempt_history.name: webkit-install-probe
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing WebKit download was available but its bundled wrapper hid inherited library paths. An isolated cache wrapper under /tmp uses existing extracted compatibility libraries; both engines subsequently passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: form-mutation-bounded-readiness
validation_attempt_history.detail: Both engines failed at the expected10-second navigation precondition after forms capability was denied. The original runner required AssertionError and rejected this result. The retained second attempt also uses no-navigation settling so the independent top-navigation count assertion is reached and fails on both engines.

validation_attempt_history.name: postinstall-preflight

validation_attempt_history.name: focused-typecheck-initial

validation_attempt_history.name: webkit-install-probe

validation_attempt_history.name: form-mutation-bounded-readiness

validation_summary: Targeted ordinary runtime checks,scoped formatting/lint and focused benchmark TypeScript check passed; all15 mutation checks detected the expected failure and restored exact source bytes.

validation_attempt_history.name: dependency-probe-skips
validation_attempt_history.detail: Before compatible mobile dependencies were linked:2 files passed,9 skipped;16 tests passed,107 skipped. No browser coverage claimed from this run.

validation_attempt_history.name: missing-generated-assets-and-webkit-libraries
validation_attempt_history.detail: After dependencies were linked,missing generated mobile engine modules and unavailable WebKit system libraries caused11 file failures:44 tests failed,46 passed,33 skipped. Generated ignored outputs and isolated WebKit cache setup resolved these failures.

validation_attempt_history.name: postinstall-preflight
validation_attempt_history.detail: pnpm attempted its automatic dependency verification first and rejected the symlink hoist directory. No successful dependency install occurred. The existing mobile postinstall generators then completed and produced the required ignored assets.

validation_attempt_history.name: focused-typecheck-initial
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing benchmark background-task discrimination and callback-assigned sink narrowing failed focused TypeScript checking. Checked narrowing and a typed sink object resolved both; final focused check passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: initial-benchmark
validation_attempt_history.detail: The6 retained benchmark arms passed before the final checked-type cleanup. Final run records its own checksum and duration.

validation_attempt_history.name: webkit-install-probe
validation_attempt_history.detail: Existing WebKit download was available but its bundled wrapper hid inherited library paths. An isolated cache wrapper under /tmp uses existing extracted compatibility libraries; both engines subsequently passed.

validation_attempt_history.name: form-mutation-bounded-readiness
validation_attempt_history.detail: Both engines failed at the expected10-second navigation precondition after forms capability was denied. The original runner required AssertionError and rejected this result. The retained second attempt also uses no-navigation settling so the independent top-navigation count assertion is reached and fails on both engines.
